additionalAbilities.name: Handling Circuit
additionalAbilities.description: The sentinel is inactive while its handling circuit is switched off. Switching the circuit off immediately ends any effect of the sentinel's Hold Position action.

additionalAbilities.name: Shutdown Latch
additionalAbilities.description: A creature within 5 feet of the sentinel can take an action to make a DC 12 Dexterity check using Thieves' Tools or a DC 12 Intelligence (Arcana) check. On a success, the sentinel becomes inactive until its handling circuit is deliberately switched on again. A failed check has no additional effect.

actions.name: Padded Clamp
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Hold Position (2/Encounter)
actions.description: The sentinel directs its handling field at one creature it can see within 15 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or have its Speed reduced to 0 until the end of the sentinel's next turn. The target can still act normally. The effect ends early if the sentinel becomes inactive or is destroyed.
